notes.title: First Person View! Achievements!
notes.content:
Now the player can go from traditional Third Person to enhanced First Person vantage point by clicking Right-Click of the Mouse.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38627081/d042be43cfde465fc5394759e1b070636dab9f1c.gif

We've gotten many requests to give Challenge Speedball to First Person view.  We hope this new vantage point will give the people what they want.

Pro Tips: First Person View is best used once the user has moved to a bunker and is taking aim at the opponent.  It is not ideal for running from bunker to bunker.   

Known Issues:  

 First Person in Prone position displays some artifacts from the camera intersecting the parts of the player mesh.  It does not affect gameplay, but it looks kind of a mess.  
 In order to prevent the camera view from being blocked by the player's head, we had to remove it (the head) at times.  Don't be alarmed if you see disappear momentarily.  It's still there and will be right back! ːsteamhappyː


Achievements!

We have added over 20 Achievements to Steam.  Let us know what you think and if you have requests for more.

Now you can augment your playing experience with custom artwork, pictures, adverts or whatever you please.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38627081/352441ec060afad8f5d1bdb939523c06a70a2ee9.png

First go to the Choose Playing Field Screen and select Custom Sign Display 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38627081/3ca941d90b5ee79a68ef9c3933084aa40db9dc8f.png

Then Add New Signs and then Add Signs To Field

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38627081/33f857c10d2dbce45195f0f7d2f92b2c5b24b2f2.png

When hosting a game, all participants will see the hosts signs (so please keep it PG-13 for the little ones).

notes.title: Named Servers and Password Protect!
notes.content:
When creating a multiplayer server, you can now give it a custom name, as well as password protect it.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38627081/59d8c8a0e3563ab006d0be856a92f8cc6b237e6c.png

When Joining those servers you will be prompted to enter that password.

notes.title: New Aiming System!
notes.content:
We've gotten a lot of requests to ditch our 'unique" aiming system.. and we listened.

[previewyoutube=ErNdR298u2U;full][/previewyoutube]

It's not perfect yet but it's pretty good.

Known issues

 Some times the paint balls come out of the gun at a funny angle.
 No color or dynamic reticle for now.
 Some options (no longer apply) have been removed from settings.


Please let us know what you think, suggestions and any bugs.

Thanks!

notes.title: Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
We have been working hard to find bugs...

Crash On Join Server - We implemented a new Steam Networking package in hopes of fixing the join bugs.
Crash on Mark Player - Fix coding error.


Please update to the newest version of Challenge Speedball
Let us know of any more suggestions or bugs.

Thanks!
Bucksoft91
